title: Sky Sharks
desc: Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated, super soldiers with supernatural powers who were able to fly & destroy

title: Spytime
desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

title: Consecration
desc: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

title: Hatching
desc: In the most terrifying creature feature Hatching is a story about lovelessness that creates a monster. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

title: Nefarious
desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

title: Night Courier
desc: From a struggling delivery man to the depths of a city's underworld, where desperation and opportunity collide, and this tantalizing opportunity comes at a great cost. Fahad a mentally fragile man racing against time must risk everything he holds dear, including his principles and the fragile sanity he clings to.
